records.title: LHC Run 3 Nominal Proton Beam Energy
records.knownLimitations: Operational beam energy is 6.8 TeV per beam during Run 3; varies slightly during commissioning and special physics runs.

records.title: LHC Superconducting Main Dipole Magnetic Field
records.knownLimitations: 8.33 T represents nominal design field at 7.0 TeV; at 6.8 TeV operating point field is approximately 8.09 T.

records.title: Higgs Boson Mass (PDG 2024 Review)
records.knownLimitations: Combined ATLAS and CMS value is 125.25 +/- 0.17 GeV. Educational simulations round to 125.0 GeV.

records.title: ATLAS Higgs Machine Learning Challenge Dataset (Simulation)
records.knownLimitations: This dataset is official ATLAS GEANT4 simulation, NOT real collision data. Features are derived specifically for machine learning exploration.

records.title: LHC-TriggerMind XGBoost Benchmark on ATLAS Higgs Simulation
records.formula: AMS = sqrt(2 * ((s + b + br) * ln(1 + s / (b + br)) - s)) with br = 10
records.knownLimitations: Evaluated on public simulated dataset; represents research exploration prototype, not operational ATLAS hardware L1 trigger.

records.title: WLCG Distributed Computing Worldwide Tier Hierarchy
records.knownLimitations: Aggregated site count and average capacities. Real grid status fluctuates continuously with dynamic site availability.
